description: The Svelte 5 data grid as the source of truth for three Chart.js charts. A mock socket pushes price ticks every 350 ms; a bar chart of price per symbol, a line chart of the last 30 ticks for the top four symbols and a doughnut of market cap by sector all read the grid's displayed rows through api.getDisplayedRows() and re-render on every tick and every filter or sort change with chart.update('none') so nothing animates on the fast cadence. Filter the Symbol column and the charts trim to match.
keywords: svelte grid filtered rows to chart

faq.question: How do the charts follow the grid filters?
faq.answer: onFiltersChange and onSortingChange call a rebuild that reads api.getDisplayedRows(), and the charts are fed from that array, so a column filter narrows the chart to the same rows.

faq.question: Why chart.update('none')?
faq.answer: It refreshes the chart without its transition animation. On a 350 ms tick an animated update would never finish and would look jittery.

faq.question: Is Chart.js part of SvGrid?
faq.answer: No. It is imported by the demo as a normal dependency; the grid only exposes the rows. The same pattern works with any chart library, or with the charts in @svgrid/enterprise.
